subject: general
question: ‘Ace Against Odds’ is the autobiography of which of the following persons?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sania Mirza.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ace Against Odds is the 2016 biography of the Indian professional tennis player Sania Mirza.
 
• Sania Mirza wrote Ace Against Odds with the help of her father and mentor Imran Mirza & sports journalist Shivani Gupta.
 
• Indian tennis star Sania Mirza posted a birthday wish for her husband Shoaib Malik on social media, calling her partner "the guy who I can't live with or without."
 
• If you do or achieve something against (all) the odds/against all odds, you do or achieve it although there were a lot of problems and you were not likely to succeed: Against all the odds, he recovered.
 
• “Ace against Odds” by Sania Mirza is an autobiography written with the help of her father Imran Mirza and sports journalist Shivani Gupta. The book is as fascinating as her tennis journey and her life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Unbreakable is an autobiography, of Mary Kom, published by Harper Collins, the book chronicles Mary's relentless struggle and an unflinching passion for boxing. "My story is the same as that of thousands of women in this country.
 
• PT Usha - Pilavullakandi Thekkeparambil Usha to use her full name - is one of India's greatest athletes, often called the country's "queen of track and field"
 
• Pilavullakandi Thekkeraparambil Usha born 27 June 1964 is a retired Indian track and field athlete. She was born in Kuttali, Kozhikode, Kerala.
 
• Indian weightlifter Karnam Malleswari holds the distinguished honour of being the first woman from India to win a medal at the Olympics. Her career's crowning achievement came at the Sydney 2000 Olympics.
